2026_01_ARI_LAC.headline: Arizona’s depleted protection and secondary give Los Angeles two pressure points
2026_01_ARI_LAC.paragraph1: Arizona reaches the opener with Isaiah Adams, Garrett Williams and Dadrion Taylor-Demerson ruled out, thinning both the offensive line and secondary, while Jeremiyah Love is questionable. Los Angeles can use that imbalance to force the Cardinals into uncomfortable choices: protect longer against pressure or speed the ball out against tighter coverage. Arizona’s best counter is to stay efficient early, keep the down-and-distance manageable and prevent the Chargers from dictating obvious passing situations.
2026_01_ARI_LAC.model_rationale: Los Angeles can stress protection and coverage on the same possessions, while Arizona needs efficient early downs to keep those vulnerabilities from becoming repeated passing-down problems.
